title: Vaulted Glass — Orbital Boardroom Monolith
description: A single dominant frosted slab floats over a deep spatial-navy field ringed by a faint orbital gradient halo. Distinguished from multi-card glass layouts by its monolithic restraint — one card, one idea, weighted and ceremonial.
philosophy: This template exists for the moment of product revelation, where silence on screen signals absolute confidence. It refuses collage, refuses competing accents, and refuses the visual noise that dilutes high-stakes announcements. The single frosted card is an architectural decision: gravity over decoration, ceremony over density. It is built for speakers who trust the idea to carry the room without scaffolding.
goodFor: Executive product title and reveal slides
Keynote opener moments requiring ceremonial weight
Investor unveils where first impressions are load-bearing
avoidFor: Team-photo or culture decks requiring warmth
author: harness

examples.promptCore: The slide should feel like a sealed chamber the instant before a curtain rises — hushed, gravitational, and ceremonial in its stillness. A single monolithic frosted panel commands the center, floating with quiet authority against an expansive deep-spatial field that rings it with a barely perceptible orbital luminescence. Compositional energy is radially inward: the eye is pulled toward the card and held there, never scattered. Avoid any secondary graphic elements, layered texture collage, or accent motifs that would dissolve the monastic restraint of a single-idea reveal.

examples.layoutNotes: Full-bleed canvas with a single centered frosted-glass card spanning cols 3–10 of a 12-col grid and sitting on the vertical midpoint, leaving equal dark field above and below. An 8% outer margin on all sides keeps the spatial-navy surround present and weighty — the emptiness is structural, not accidental. Title and subtitle stack centrally within the card, hierarchy enforced by size contrast alone with no rule lines, dividers, or decorative insets. A diffuse orbital gradient halo emanates from behind the card into the surrounding field, softening the card's edge without competing with it.

examples.promptCore: The content slide sustains the ceremonial stillness of the title moment, now crystallized around a single weighted idea — a number, a verdict, or a stripped declaration — that inhabits the frosted slab with architectural inevitability. Compositional rhythm is concentric and breath-held: depth radiates outward from the card's one content node into the surrounding spatial field, reinforcing gravity over density. Avoid any secondary callout boxes, decorative icon clusters, or layered glass panels that fracture the monolith. The mood is an executive silence — the kind where the room stops moving because the slide has already said everything.

examples.layoutNotes: The single frosted card remains the sole compositional anchor, centered on a 12-column grid occupying cols 2–11 with roughly 14–16% vertical breathing margin above and below. Within the card, a single dominant content node — a large stat, a two-line declarative quote, or a short hero statement — sits in the upper two-thirds of the card interior, with a thin rule line separating a sparse attribution or label below. Page number appears bottom-right in the outer field, outside the card boundary. No header band, no sidebar, no secondary card or competing panel.
